sections.tldr: TL;DR: The Integral University online BCA is a UGC-DEB approved three-year Bachelor of Computer Applications, delivered fully online. Integral University holds NAAC A+ accreditation. Offered as a broad BCA covering the core curriculum. It suits students who have finished 10+2 and want a recognised BCA they can complete online. For the current confirmed fee and EMI options, speak with our counsellor, since the fee for this programme is verified case by case rather than published as a fixed table.

hero.headline: Integral University Online BCA
hero.sub: A UGC-DEB approved, NAAC A+ Bachelor of Computer Applications, delivered online.

ugcDeb.heading: Integral University Online BCA: UGC-DEB Approval and Validity
ugcDeb.body: The UGC Distance Education Bureau regulates every online degree in India. Integral University is UGC-DEB entitled for online delivery, which means this BCA is valid for government and PSU recruitment, for private-sector employment, and for higher study at recognised Indian universities. Integral University also holds NAAC A+ accreditation. Always confirm the current entitlement for your admission year at deb.ugc.ac.in before you enrol.

abcId.heading: Academic Bank of Credits (ABC ID)
abcId.body: Every student in a UGC-approved online programme needs an Academic Bank of Credits (ABC) ID. You create it free on the ABC portal at abc.gov.in, usually through your DigiLocker account. As you clear each semester of the Integral University online BCA, your credits are deposited against this ID, which makes it easier to carry credits forward or move to an MCA or a master's in computing later. Keep the same ABC ID through the whole three-year programme.

redFlags.heading: What to Check Before You Enrol

flags.sentence1: Integral University does not publish a single fixed fee table for this online BCA.
flags.sentence2: Get the current fee and any EMI terms confirmed in writing before you pay, rather than relying on a figure quoted elsewhere.

flags.sentence1: This is a fully online programme with no on-campus classes.
flags.sentence2: If you want in-person teaching or a campus experience, this is not the right format for you.

flags.sentence1: Online study is self-driven and career support is not guaranteed.
flags.sentence2: Plan to build your own study routine, and expect to run your own job search after you graduate.

flags.sentence1: UGC-DEB entitlement is granted intake by intake.
flags.sentence2: Confirm that Integral University is on the current approved list at deb.ugc.ac.in for your admission year before you enrol.

faqs.question: Is the Integral University online BCA valid?
faqs.answer: Yes. Integral University is UGC-DEB entitled for online delivery and holds NAAC A+. The BCA is valid for employment, for government and PSU recruitment, and for higher study at recognised Indian universities. Confirm the current status at deb.ugc.ac.in.

faqs.question: Who can apply for the Integral University online BCA?
faqs.answer: You need a pass in 10+2 (any stream, mathematics preferred) from a recognised board. The online format lets you study from anywhere on your own schedule. Confirm the exact cut-off with the university before applying.

faqs.question: How long is the Integral University online BCA?
faqs.answer: It is a three-year programme delivered fully online, which lets you study around work or other commitments.

faqs.question: Who should consider the Integral University online BCA?
faqs.answer: It suits students who have finished 10+2 and want a recognised BCA they can complete online, and carries local weight around Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. For the BCA you would study programming, web and application development, databases and the foundations of computer science, and typical early roles include junior software developer, web developer, quality analyst. Many graduates go on to an MCA or a master's in computing.

faqs.question: What is the fee for the Integral University online BCA?
faqs.answer: The current confirmed fee is verified case by case rather than published as a fixed table. Speak with our counsellor for the latest fee and EMI options, and confirm the figure with the university in writing before you pay.
